overloadPatches.semanticRole: Gets a row range from the table intersecting a range, element, or 4D Write Pro document; returns Null if no such intersection exists.

discriminatedBy.note: single Object arg resolved as a range/element/document rather than a raw table reference

overloadPatches.semanticRole: Gets a row range from a table, addressed by table reference and explicit start row (with optional row count, defaulting to a single row).

discriminatedBy.note: 2-3 arg form addressing a table by reference plus explicit row index

overloadMerges.note: autoparse typed the third overload's 'headers' parameter as free Text, but the doc table's Description column ('wk header rows') and prose show it is actually the reserved wk header rows constant used as a mode flag, not arbitrary text; added as an explicit sentinelValue.

params.name: headers
params.description: Pass the wk header rows constant to get the table's repeated header row(s)

sentinelValues.meaning: Return the repeated header rows of the table instead of body rows

overloadMerges.semanticRole: Gets the repeated header row(s) of a table by passing the wk header rows constant instead of a start row index.

constraints: If numRows is omitted, only the single startRow row is returned.
If startRow+numRows exceeds the number of rows in tableRef, or startRow is greater than the number of rows, the returned range is clamped to the maximum possible rows.
In the headers form, any numRows parameter is ignored; the command returns Null if the table has no defined header rows.
